g.text: FRESCA PREMIER FRESH · Display tray 12 × 250 g · MANGETOUT
Die-line v1, print side up, scale 1:1, mm. Outside 390 × 290 × 200 (front lip 75). Board: white-top E/B flute, 4 mm. Inks: forest, mid green, gold + full-colour logo.
Structure and art by sharl-tech for Fresca, 12 Oct 2026. Confirm board calliper and punnet size with the converter before cutting tools are made.
